column1: # B1053 (#373): open the Options window and take one still per tab, in XML
# tab order. MEASURED on lane 5 (1280x1024 Xorg; the driver's still crops
# 1280x800 at +0+30, so root y = crop y + 30, root x = crop x). In the probe
# still the window's top border is at crop y=349 and its left edge at

# anchor (that deviation is exactly what the side-by-side records). The tab
